app.name: Rinda

roleHelp.facilitator: Run study sessions and support participants.
roleHelp.researcher_admin: Manage accounts, content and study data.

subtitle.facilitator: Your sessions and the participants you support.

dashboard.noCheckups: You have not done a check-up yet.
dashboard.noSafety: No safety events in the last 30 days.
dashboard.deletionRequested: You asked us to delete your data. We will finish within 14 days.

hints.participants_total: Everyone taking part in the study
hints.users_total: All roles, active and turned off
hints.sus_responses: Participants with a complete usability form

profile.title: Profile
profile.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Other devices were signed out.
profile.aboutHint: These help the app read some results. You can leave them as they are.
profile.deleteBody: You can leave the study at any time. We will delete your check-ups and details within 72 hours.
profile.deleteConfirm: Do you want us to delete your data? This cannot be undone once it is done.
profile.consentsBody: Change these choices at any time. Each change is saved as a new record. To stop taking part completely, ask for your data to be deleted below.
profile.deleteDue: Your data will be deleted by {{date}}.

checkup.title: Health check-up
checkup.intro: Answer what you can. You can skip any question. Skipping never counts against you.

sources.recalled: From memory or a recent reading

issues.out_of_range: This reading looks outside the usual range. Please check it.
issues.height_in_metres: Height is in centimetres, for example 165.
issues.weight_check: Please check this weight. It should be in kilograms.
issues.systolic_not_above_diastolic: The top number should be higher than the bottom number.

wellness.declined: You chose to skip the mood and stress questions.
wellness.stopped: You stopped the mood and stress questions. You can still send the rest of your check-up.

camera.title: Read your blood pressure monitor
camera.intro: Point the camera at the monitor's screen. The picture stays on this device and is never saved or sent.
camera.hold: Fit the numbers inside the frame and hold still.
camera.noCamera: The camera is not available here. You can use a photo, or type the numbers yourself.
camera.notRead: We could not read the numbers. Try moving closer and avoiding glare, or type them yourself.
camera.check: Check these match the monitor before you use them.

results.title: My results
results.deleteConfirm: Delete this check-up and its results? This cannot be undone.
results.educational: These results are educational, not a diagnosis. They are not an emergency service.
results.keepGoing: All the areas you answered are in the recommended range. Keep going.
results.urgent: Your blood pressure reading is very high. Please get help today.

targets.activity_split: About {{minutesPerDay}} more minutes on {{days}} days this week
targets.diet_servings: Add {{servings}} servings of fruit or vegetables a day

results.noStep: No change needed here. Keep going.

help.title: Get help
help.intro: Free and confidential services you can call.

charts.bpEmpty: Add a blood pressure reading in your next check-up to see it here.
charts.dietEmpty: Your fruit and vegetable servings will appear here.

home.heroTitle: Let's look after your everyday health
home.heroSubtitle: Small steps add up. Here is where you stand today.
home.firstCheckup: Start with a short check-up. It takes about five minutes.

guidePanel.title: Ask Rinda
guidePanel.intro: Pick a question. Rinda answers from your own results.
guidePanel.needCheckup: Do a check-up first so Rinda can answer.
guidePanel.offline: You are offline, so Rinda answered from approved guidance on this phone.

offline.savedOnPhone: Saved on this phone, not sent yet
offline.provisionalTitle: Your results, worked out on this phone
offline.provisionalBody: You are offline. These results will be checked again and saved when you are back online.

install.title: Install Rinda
install.body: Add Rinda to your home screen so it opens like an app and keeps working without internet.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.installed: Rinda is installed on this device.

aiOptIn.title: AI explanations
aiOptIn.body: Let an AI service reword the approved explanation of your results. It receives only your result words and numbers, never your name, contact details or mental-wellness answers. You can switch this off at any time.
aiOptIn.toggle: Use AI to explain my results
aiOptIn.unavailable: AI explanations are not switched on yet. You still get the approved explanations.

emailReports.title: Email reports
emailReports.body: Get a summary of each check-up by email: the result for each area and one small first step. Mood and stress results are never emailed. Anyone who can open your email can read it.
emailReports.needEmail: This needs an account with an email address.
emailReports.unavailable: Email reports are not switched on yet.
emailReports.sent: The summary was sent to your email.
emailReports.sendFailed: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.

consent.needConnection: Rinda needs an internet connection the first time, to save your consent choices. Please connect and try again.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp notices
whatsapp.body: Get a WhatsApp message when your check-up summary is ready. The message never includes your results.
whatsapp.needPhone: Add your phone number in "My details" to use this.
whatsapp.unavailable: WhatsApp notices are not switched on yet.

working.title: Setting up this phone…
working.body: Linking this phone to your Rinda session.

done.title: This phone is ready
done.body: Taking you to sign in. Everything is cleared from this phone when the session ends.

failed.title: This code did not work
failed.body: It may have expired or already been used. Ask the facilitator for a new code.
